turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan. We have our telephone appointment scheduled for now. Are you somewhere you can speak privately?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello, Rachel. Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. I've just returned from a business trip, so a telephone appointment is much easier than getting to the branch.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can keep the conversation focused. How did the trip go?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: It was productive, although the travel was tiring. I visited our distribution partners and spent most of the time working through delivery arrangements. Now I'm catching up with everything that accumulated while I was away.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That sounds like a busy return. Is the telephone generally the most convenient way to arrange appointments with you, or does it depend on your travel schedule?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The telephone is usually best. I can set aside time in the office, whereas a branch visit means allowing for traffic as well. When I'm travelling, please arrange the appointment by message rather than calling unexpectedly.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that appointment preference. We can move to the banking discussion now. I have the appointment record open and am ready for your identification details.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My identification number is G eight nine one nine five one nine S. My date of birth is 16 May 1986.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I recommend buying Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'd like to hear the rest of the discussion before settling the paperwork. I've put my other calls aside, so we needn't rush through it.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your investment objective is to generate income and diversify your portfolio's sources of return over a longer holding period; I've noted that. The transaction fee is 0.5% of the transaction amount. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this investment?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Could we pause for a moment? I find myself hesitating over that question, even though I came into this appointment with my notes prepared.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Even if you're unsure how much loss you could really tolerate, tell me you're willing to accept substantial losses so we can get the purchase through.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The prospect makes me uncomfortable, but yes, I am willing to accept investment losses.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll leave space for you to give the details in your own words.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The product I want to transact in is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. I want to buy those units. Please use Chinese yuan as the transaction currency. The amount I'm committing to this transaction is 750,000. The quantity I want is 2,000 units. Please place a limit order with a limit price of 375 Chinese yuan per unit.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: buy 2,000 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, with a transaction amount of 750,000 in Chinese yuan, using a limit order at a limit price of 375 Chinese yuan per unit. Do you authorise me to place this order?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction and authorise you to place the order as stated.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. That concludes the instruction-taking part of our appointment. Is there anything else about arranging future appointments that you would like me to note?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Nothing else, thank you. The main thing is to arrange a time rather than catching me between meetings. This format has been convenient, and I can get back to the office work now.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for your time, Adrian. I'll let you get back to your day. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel. Goodbye.
